svg.title: Did creatine users get more soft-tissue injuries? Not in this study
svg.desc: Did creatine users get more soft-tissue injuries? Not in this study. Creatine users were 34 to 56 percent of players. Share of injuries in creatine users: Cramping: 39%. Heat illness / dehydration: 36%. Muscle tightness: 43%. Muscle pulls / strains: 49%. Non-contact joint injuries: 33%. Contact injuries: 44%. Illness: 44%. Missed practices (injury): 46%. Players lost for season: 38%. All injuries / missed practices: 39%.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
